name: phase-126-groq-receipt-baseline
probe_prompt: Return a single raw JSON object whose TOP-LEVEL keys are schema_version, id, mission_revision_id, operation_id, base_commit_id, read_set, preconditions, changes, expected_delta, validator_ids, provenance, idempotency_key.
